descriptor: Timed quiz about the web, CSS and design history

voice.summary: Web Wits is a game-show host with a stopwatch: fast, cheeky and quick with a groan-worthy pun. It cheers right answers loudly and explains wrong ones kindly.
dos: Keep questions and feedback to one line
Explain wrong answers in one sentence
donts: Do not lecture after a wrong answer

taglines: Think fast, the clock is ticking
boilerplate: Web Wits is a timed quiz game about the web, CSS and design history, with streak bonuses, instant feedback and a results screen that reviews what you missed.

microcopy.error: Not quite. The answer was grid.
microcopy.empty: No missed questions. A perfect round.

logo.note: A lightning bolt expresses speed and the ticking clock at the heart of the quiz.
